mapper.sql: select o.offset_id, o.settle_id, o.offset_amount, o.offset_date, o.audit_status, o.audit_by, o.audit_time, o.audit_opinion, o.msg_id, o.create_by, o.create_time, o.update_by, o.update_time, o.remark, s.settle_no, s.customer_id, s.customer_name, s.rebate_amount from mk_rebate_offset o inner join mk_rebate_settle s on o.settle_id = s.settle_id
mapper.select: where o.settle_id = #{settleId} order by o.offset_id desc
select IFNULL(sum(offset_amount), 0) from mk_rebate_offset where settle_id = #{settleId} and audit_status = '1'
mapper.insert: insert into mk_rebate_offset (settle_id, offset_amount, offset_date, audit_status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{settleId}, #{offsetAmount}, #{offsetDate}, #{auditStatus}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
